           a.last_round as prev_last, 
           b.first_round as next_first,
           a.constructor_id as prev_constructor, 
           b.constructor_id as next_constructor,
           b.first_round - a.last_round - 1 as races_missed,
           a.last_round + 1 as first_missed_round,
           b.first_round - 1 as last_missed_round
    FROM driver_drives a
    JOIN driver_drives b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
    WHERE b.first_round > a.last_round
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, first_missed_round, last_missed_round, races_missed,
           prev_constructor, next_constructor
    FROM consecutive_pairs
    WHERE races_missed > 0 AND races_missed < 3
    AND prev_constructor != next_constructor
)
SELECT q.year, q.driver_id, q.first_missed_round, q.last_missed_round,
       q.prev_constructor as drive_prev, q.next_constructor as drive_next,
       (SELECT dr.constructor_id FROM results dr JOIN races r ON dr.race_id = r.race_id 
        WHERE r.year = q.year AND dr.driver_id = q.driver_id AND r.round = q.first_missed_round - 1) as result_before,
       (SELECT dr.constructor_id FROM results dr JOIN races r ON dr.race_id = r.race_id 
        WHERE r.year = q.year AND dr.driver_id = q.driver_id AND r.round = q.last_missed_round + 1) as result_after
FROM qualified q
LIMIT 20
